title: Rav Sama son of Rava
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bava Metzia 42b before Rav Ashi in the cited passage. In Chullin 47b he said: “A lung that looks like a kushta or like saffron is terefah.” He is likewise mentioned in Zevachim 16a.
In the Epistle of Rav Sherira Gaon, part 3, chapter 4, Rav Sherira says that Rav Sama was head of the academy in Pumbedita from the year 757 until 787.

notes.text: “Before Rav Ashi” can describe appearing before him in the cited passage; it does not alone prove an earlier generation. The supplied years and the earlier uncertainty about their era remain unconverted.
The consulted Chullin 47b also includes an egg-like color in Rav Sama’s comparison.
